name: @ledger/api
description: FastAPI over DuckDB. The Python side lives in .venv, set up by pnpm api:setup at the repo root.

scripts.audit: uv export --locked --extra dev --no-emit-project --quiet -o "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ledger-api-requirements.txt" && uvx --from pip-audit==2.10.1 pip-audit --require-hashes --disable-pip -r "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ledger-api-requirements.txt"
